title: The Dishwasher Tetris War
style: comedy ska, 132 BPM, brass stabs, upstroke guitar, walking bass, snappy snare, female and male duet trading lines, kitchen ambient SFX, theatrical exasperation, sing-along chorus
lyrics:
[Intro — kitchen ambience, plate clatter, ska brass stab]
You did NOT just put the bowl on the bottom rack
You did NOT just put the spoon facing back

[Verse 1 — partner A, exasperated female]
I am an engineer of the dishwasher arts
Forks in their slots, bowls in their parts
You come along like a hurricane in shoes
Throwin' in casserole dishes any way you choose

[Pre-Chorus — partner B, defensive male]
It's just a dishwasher, it ain't rocket science
The water gets in there with reckless compliance
Whatever I throw in there comes out clean
What's the big deal, what does it mean?

[Chorus — both, chaotic ska]
The dishwasher tetris war!
The dishwasher tetris war!
Bowls on the BOTTOM, mugs on the TOP
The plates face inward, when will it stop?
The dishwasher tetris war!
The dishwasher tetris war!

[Verse 2 — partner A]
The cutting board does NOT go on its side
It blocks the spinny thing that washes the inside
You put a wooden spoon in for the seventh time
Wooden things hand-wash, that is the chime!

[Pre-Chorus — partner B]
I rinse them first, isn't that enough?
I scrape the plate, I do the rough stuff
You're acting like I committed a crime
By using the appliance one extra time

[Chorus — both, ska brass]
The dishwasher tetris war!
The dishwasher tetris war!
Bowls on the BOTTOM, mugs on the TOP
The plates face inward, when will it stop?
The dishwasher tetris war!
The dishwasher tetris war!

[Bridge — both, calmer, spoken]
[A] Just… let me load it.
[B] You let me load it last week.
[A] Yes, and I had to redo it.
[B] You redid it?
[A] Of course I redid it.
[B] …I'm getting takeaway.

[Outro — ska wind down]
The dishwasher tetris war!
Forty years of marriage and we never won the war!
The dishwasher tetris war!
